name: review
description: Code-review toolkit: eight agents, read-only over the reviewed code (code, security, architecture, doc drift, build/test/lint, CI-log audit, a brief-driven reviewer, and a findings-pipeline normalizer), plus orchestration skills for the quality gate, fan-out, and enforceability audit (/review:audit-enforceability), a pull-request change digest with an interactive view (/review:explain-change), a fan-out sweep workflow (/review:fanout-sweep), and CI lane commands (/review:code-review, /review:security-review) for org reusable workflows.
